opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland (or have a substantial recent connection to Scotland), are ineligible for government tuition fee support, and are enrolled on or have an unconditional offer for an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish institution. Applicants must not have already graduated with a university degree (except for limited second-degree cases). Household gross income thresholds apply (e.g. £30,000 single person, no children).
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for individuals from low-income households who want to study for a first degree at a Scottish university (or a second degree in limited subject areas) and who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government. Grants cover tuition fees up to £1,820 per year. Applications processed on a first come first served basis for academic year 2026-27.
